### R Code

Each script reproduces every output printed on the matching slides. `Class3.R`,
`Class4.R` and `Class6.R` read the data files listed below by relative paths, so run
them from the folder that contains `data/`; `Class6.R` writes its figures to a
`Figures/` folder it creates. `Class5.R` needs no data file.

- [Lecture 3 - `Class3.R`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Class3.R)
- [Lecture 4 - `Class4.R`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Class4.R)
- [Lecture 5 - `Class5.R`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Class5.R)
- [Lecture 6 - `Class6.R`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_Class6.R)

### Data

The running example for the course. Neither analysis file sits ready-made on a portal:
both were cut from the national releases by the build script, so you can rebuild either one.

- [`municipios_clean.csv`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_municipios_clean.csv) — 2,469 municipios: population, schooling, illiteracy, poverty rates
- [`enigh_hogares_raw.csv`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_enigh_hogares_raw.csv) — 91,414 households: income, household size, state, survey weight
- [`coneval_pobreza.csv`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_coneval_pobreza.csv) — CONEVAL poverty indicators, for the join exercises
- [`build_data_real.R`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_build_data_real.R) — the script that produces all three
- [`coneval_municipal_2020_raw.csv`](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_coneval_municipal_2020_raw.csv) — 2,469 × 37, the CONEVAL release **uncleaned**: this is the file Lecture 4 cleans on screen
- [Read me first](https://github.com/mauricioromero86/mauricioromero86.github.io/releases/download/teaching-archive/AnalisisEmpirico_202602_data_README.md) — provenance, attribution, and what to read before you compute anything

Sources: INEGI, [Censo de Población y Vivienda 2020](https://www.inegi.org.mx/programas/ccpv/2020/) ·
INEGI, [ENIGH 2024](https://www.inegi.org.mx/programas/enigh/nc/2024/) ·
CONEVAL, [Medición de la pobreza municipal 2020](https://www.coneval.org.mx/Medicion/Paginas/Pobreza-municipio-2010-2020.aspx).
Accessed 2026-08-16. Nothing in these files is simulated or imputed.
